definitions.definition: (transitive, intransitive) To use a car horn.
(intransitive) To make a loud, harsh sound like a car horn.
(intransitive) To make the vocal sound of a goose.

quote.text: WAYNE: Phil, what are you doing here? You're partied out, man. Again.GARTH: What if he honks in the car?

definitions.definition: (informal) To squeeze playfully, usually a breast or nose.
The harsh note produced by a typical car horn.

quote.citation: 1961 July, J. Geoffrey Todd, “Impressions of railroading in the United States:Part Two”, in Trains Illustrated, page 424:
quote.text: The operator went out on to the platform with his handlamp and waved it in the traditional "wash-out" signal across the body. The engineer had been expecting this and responded at once with an acknowledging honk on the horn before bringing this huge, 16-car train gently to a stand at the platform.

definitions.definition: The cry of a goose or similar bird.
Imitation of car horn, used, for example, to clear a path for oneself.
